name: bubble_sort
summary: Swap adjacent out-of-order pairs each pass, stopping early once a pass makes no swap.
vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [5,3,8,1,9,2,7], run(a) { const n = a.length; for (let end = n - 1; end >= 1; end--) { let swapped = false; for (let i = 0; i < end; i++) { a.cursor('i', i); if (a.compare(i, i + 1) > 0) { a.swap(i, i + 1); swapped = true; } } a.mark(end, 'sorted'); if (!swapped) break; } a.markSorted(); } })
